HMPV virus has arrived in India🇮🇳. 
1. Wash hands frequently with soap and water. 🧼
2. Avoid close contact with sick individuals. 🤧
3. Disinfect commonly touched surfaces. 🧽
4. Wear a mask in crowded places if cases are high. 😷
5. Stay home
